Backstage programme

Your move,
told in video.

Future customers want to see what a move really looks like: the first week’s boxes, the truck at the door, the first room set up. Each month we follow 3 moves on video. If you agree to yours being one of them, we thank you with 10% off your quote.

Get my quoteWhat we never film
−10 %off your quote

3 moves a month

In three steps

How it works.

  1. 1

    You tell us

    Tick the “Backstage programme” box in your quote request, or mention it to your adviser. We come back to you within one working day.

  2. 2

    We agree the frame

    Before filming, we decide together what can be filmed and what stays private. It is written into the image-rights agreement you sign.

  3. 3

    The discount lands on the quote

    The 10% appears directly on your quote, before you sign. Nothing to claim afterwards.

The filming thread

From the first box
to your first coffee at home.

A few minutes of filming at each stage — never a whole day with a camera behind you.

  1. J-30

    The move is decided

    The home still as it was, the first questions, the sorting that begins.

  2. J-15

    The boxes arrive

    Supplies delivered, the first room packed, the checklist on the wall.

  3. J-7

    The final week

    The paperwork, the children helping, the flat emptying out.

  4. Jour J

    The team arrives

    The truck at the door, floors protected, the first piece of furniture going down.

  5. Jour J

    Loading

    The furniture lift, the crew at work, one last look round the empty home.

  6. Jour J

    Arrival

    Unloading, reassembly, the first room set up.

  7. J+15

    Your story

    A few words at home, settled in, entirely in your own terms.

Your privacy

What we never
film.

The list below applies by default, without you having to ask. You can add to it as much as you like before filming.

  • Children’s bedrooms and minors’ faces, without your written consent.
  • Your paperwork, screens, post and valuables.
  • Your quote amount and your contact details.
  • Identifiable neighbours and passers-by.
  • Any room or moment you ask us to leave out, on the day, with no explanation needed.
Your rights

You stay in control,
from start to finish.

You review first

You see every video before it is published and can ask for a cut.

Withdrawal

You can withdraw your consent at any time: we take the videos down.

Where it appears

The videos appear on CODEM’s social media and on this site, nowhere else.

Never sold on

The footage is never sold or passed to a third party, and never used in paid advertising without your agreement.

Programme limited to 3 moves a month. The discount cannot be combined beyond 15% with a seasonal offer. The final terms are set out in the image-rights agreement signed before filming.
